acceptanceCriteria: A read-only command or an ocm-prepare output lists every extracted claim selector for the cited test files, or the normalization is documented with examples in the OCM spec.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the Beamfall PTR orientation run (beamfall/core#32). A case named `PTR-V0-003 two bound checks versions is tampered` is addressed as `case:ptr-v0-two-bound-check-version-is-tampered`: numeric suffixes are dropped and `checks`/`versions` are singularized. The operator had to probe each fragment through failed `ocm link` calls. No command lists the selectors OCM extracted for a test file.
title: ocm: claim selector normalization drops digits and singularizes words, so adopters must guess case selectors
